title: Fix Object Pack operating-workflow id double prefix
desired_change: Stop prefixing workflow. onto OBJECT_ID in OPERATING-WORKFLOW.template.yaml so generated workflow packs keep a single stable object id.
expected_outcome: Scaffolded packs remain referentially coherent across MANIFEST and OPERATING-WORKFLOW modules.

risk.rights_or_safety_impact: Duplicate kind prefixes create ambiguous object identity in generated packs.

hidden_context_dependencies: OBJECT_ID values are already kind-qualified in scaffolder usage.
acceptance_checks: Generated OPERATING-WORKFLOW metadata.id equals the provided OBJECT_ID.
Scaffolder unit tests pass for agent and non-agent families.
resolution_note: Implemented on the issue #26 evaluation branch during non-agent pack review.
